status: Active private testnet default; original pool retained for recovery in the current app

initialReadback.boundary: Trusted RPC initial state only; no future solvency, independent audit or production setup claim.

limits: Valueless Stellar testnet only. No real user wallet or funds were used.
Result fee fields are separate from net account balance changes and refunds. The aggregate cap covers signed maxima across deployment, acquisition and both lifecycles, not a measured net spend.

Native and USDC flows used the actual planner, pinned real Groth16 proofs and clients, with distinct private roles but one dedicated CLI fee payer. They do not establish network anonymity or a real browser wallet payment.
Scoped disclosure used simulated decision authorities and one operator holding all five development trustee shares. It does not establish lawful authorization or independent custody.
The first disclosure attempt correctly rejected writable parent directories; the successful separate attempt used a protected home directory. Both reports and durable replay records are retained.
Accepted record recovery was exercised; live archival restoration was not. Local native and WASM storage tests remain separate evidence.
No independent audit, production ceremony or exploit-free guarantee.
Recovery-only is a policy of the current application. Older clients and direct calls can still fund the immutable original pool, which retains the documented issuer backing limitation.
